observations.comedy_and_voices: Buddy carefully fitting his hollow creates a quiet want before Neet immediately mobilizes. Neet demanding an answer from the empty post gives his competence an affectionate excess. Heather cuts through the ceremony with practical banana reassurance and the vegetable-at-door instruction. Shadow supplies the cabbage observation; Buddy converts flair into a practical question. Distinct voices remain clear.
observations.cause_effect_and_payoff: Cry causes rescue; separate monkey defenses cause retreat. Buddy actively redirects from pursuit to the unattended seller, stops one tomato and chooses comfort. Rewards follow rescue; Neet standing on cabbages motivates the leaf on his foot. Returning for the stick closes Buddy’s opening location and the stubborn leaf turns command into domestic comedy. The seller head-rub pays off his earlier decision without a joke overriding it.
image_placement: Bananas image follows the final bark, after monkey departure: fallen fruit, empty post and Neet upward gaze agree exactly. The still solemn vigilance extends the comic pause.

Comfort image follows Buddy returning to the hand after nudging one tomato: seated smiling seller, hand contact, scattered tomatoes and tomato by her crate support the quiet counterpoint. No reward basket prematurely appears.

Reward image follows Shadow noticing cabbage, before Neet’s flair answer and dignified step. Leaf wraps the grounded paw, basket and Buddy biscuit belong to the reward state. The image forms an intentional visual pause between complete attributed dialogue paragraphs; attribution is not split and the later doorway payoff remains unspoiled.
observations.complementary_contribution: Three distinct functions: comic solitary vigilance, intimate chosen kindness, and shared physical callback. Setting and evening market continuity hold. Focused framing can omit Shadow, Chikki and Heather without removing them from the scene. The closing prose receives clear space after the last picture.
